newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan buries pilot of Belgian air show crash.
newsitem.headline: Jordan buries pilot of Belgian air show crash.

text.p: Jordan buried on Monday with military honours the aerobatic pilot who crashed at an airshow in Belgium on Saturday, killing himself and eight others.
Bedouin guards fired a final volley over the grave of 28-year-old Captain Amr Hani Bilal of Jordan's Royal Falcons display team after he was buried in Amman's royal cemetery.
Bilal's plane spun out of control during a solo display at the weekend show in Ostend, crashing and raining debris on the crowd and spraying people with burning fuel.
Dozens of people were taken to hospital with injuries.
Aviation experts said Bilal's German-made Falcon XT 300 had failed to pull up, which could point to mechanical failure.
Alternatively, he could have passed out during a series of horizontal spins which involve great strain on plane and pilot from the forces of gravity.
The official Petra news agency said on Monday Foreign Minister Fayez al-Tarawnah sent a message of condolence to the Belgian government and wished a rapid recovery to the injured.
